provenance: Literal expectations derived from cumulative R2/R3/R4 specification. Canonical JSON and SHA-256 are independently encoded/hashed from those literal envelopes, never obtained from product execution. No reducer oracle is implemented here.

positives.name: one_second

positives.name: unknown
positives.derivation: R3 vector 3: unknown occurrence retains exact position, forces O false.

positives.name: repeat_seek_gaps

positives.name: unknown_to_known

positives.name: coverage_declaration

positives.name: large_tick_small_delta

positives.name: large_source_bin_boundary
positives.derivation: 48000*2^27=6442450944000; exact width*1398=9006546419712000. Two frames straddle this exact integer boundary, one in each adjacent bin.

positives.name: maximum_safe_source_end

positives.name: known_to_unknown

positives.name: boundary_known_again
